decisive_spans.text: Tumor epithelium with multiple papillary projections with vascular, plasma cell–rich stroma
Revealed a circumscribed tumor contiguous with adjoining normal epidermis and delineated from underlying dermis by continuous apocrine epithelial lining
Adjacent skin showed dermal papillae with congophilic amorphous eosinophilic deposits

response.rationale: The vignette describes a circumscribed tumor with apocrine epithelial lining, multiple papillary projections with vascular, plasma cell-rich stroma, and adjacent skin showing dermal papillae with congophilic amorphous eosinophilic deposits. These features are all explicitly supported by D2. D10 also supports these features, but D2 is a more specific diagnosis that encompasses all the findings.
